scope: Design only. No GPU execution or expenditure authorized by this file.
metric: Aggregate per-class TP/FP/FN over all original-image pixels, then macro-average four IoUs

E_NEG.question: Known-negative validity restoration, not a new label-rasterization method
E_NEG.source: User confirms official pixel GT losslessly converted to polygons
E_NEG.affected_HE_windows: Count before launch; one affected image does not mean one window
E_NEG.eval_contract: DDR val/test GT pixels, ignores, evaluator and threshold remain unchanged; only external IDRiD training validity changes
E_NEG.change: For complete official negative annotations only: target=0, valid=1 on real image; preserve padding and true unknown/uncertain ignores
E_NEG.control: Archived Q_MIX of same seed at same 24000 endpoint, only if all non-treatment identities match
E_NEG.initialization: Same original pretrained backbone and decoder initialization as archived Q_MIX

F4_F12.question: Adaptation depth with matched continuation/reheating control
F4_F12.optimizer: Fresh AdamW for both arms, not claimed as full optimizer-state resume
F4_F12.F12_trainable: all blocks and patch embedding plus forward-active backbone parameters, final norm, decoder/RGB
F4_F12.block_peak_lr: 1e-5 * 0.8**(11 - zero_based_block_index), identical for matching trainable groups in both arms
F4_F12.reheating_note: Block11 peak 1e-5 is twice old Q backbone peak 5e-6. Both arms intentionally restart; only paired F12 minus F4 isolates adaptation depth.
F4_F12.schedule_after_warmup: Cosine to 1 percent of each group's peak at update 12000
F4_F12.loss: Unchanged Q 0.5 masked BCE + 0.5 masked microbatch Dice
F4_F12.sampling: Original 4 foreground + 4 uniform per effective update; same new stream per paired seed, train labels only

resources.prestart_alternative_for_both_arms_only: micro1 accumulation8, document microbatch-Dice semantic change

F4_F12.catastrophic_stop: At both 2000 and 4000: single >=2pp below its initial Q, and 25-percent fusion >=1pp below corresponding R. Stop affected arm; no fabricated 12k matched comparison.

promotion.meaning: Resource allocation threshold, not significance or target attainment

final_selection.metric: Mean of two seed validation mIoUs
final_selection.tie_definition: Exact equality of unrounded mean validation mIoU, not equal rounded display values
final_selection.test_gate: Both seeds positive versus corresponding R and mean new val gain >=0.5pp; freeze recipe and formula before test

hardware: One user-assigned 24GB GPU, serial; full-backprop benchmark required before exact time/cost
limits: No guarantee that target will be reached
No new architecture novelty claim from fine-tuning alone
